description: Fixed evaluation set for the rules assistant retriever (docs/ASSISTANT-EVAL.md). Every expected id is a compendium entry "<type>:<id>" whose real text answers the question (any one of them counts). kind: direct = the entry name is in the question; paraphrase = it is not; facts = the answer is in the entry's structured data (hit die, AC, hit points...).
